name: open_graphics_library
description: Opens graphics.library through the exec open-library call and stores the returned library base in a global. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: close_library_from_global
description: Closes the library whose base is held in the shared global block, using the exec close-library call. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: open_diskfont_library
description: Opens diskfont.library through the exec open-library call and stores the returned library base in a global. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: close_library_from_global
description: Closes the library whose base is held in the shared global block, using the exec close-library call. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: open_iff_library
description: Opens iff.library through the exec open-library call and stores the result in a global. If the open fails, it sets a global flag, and the routine carries an error message about a missing iff.library in the libs directory.

name: close_library_from_global
description: Closes the library whose base is held in the shared global block, using the exec close-library call. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: load_music_file_into_memory
description: Reads the free memory reported by the system, sizes a buffer in tiers from that figure, and allocates it through exec. It then opens the MegaBall.Music file, reads it into the buffer, and closes the file.

name: load_scores_file
description: Opens the MegaBall.scores file, copies its contents word by word into a fixed global area up to a set end address, and closes the file.

name: save_scores_file
description: Opens the MegaBall.scores file for writing, writes the stored score data to it, and closes the file again.

name: load_ball2_iff_picture
description: Loads the BALL2.IFF picture through iff.library and records its result in a global. If the colour table cannot be fetched, it reports an error and releases the IFF data with a library call.

name: stub_empty_return
description: A single return instruction with no work, reached from two callers. It does nothing and is not a real routine.

name: decode_iff_picture
description: Calls iff.library to decode a loaded picture. If decoding fails, it marks the failure in a global and releases the IFF data with a second library call.

name: open_custom_screen
description: Opens a custom Intuition screen through intuition.OpenScreen and stores its handle in a global. If the open fails, it sets a global flag, and the routine carries an error message about a custom screen.

name: open_auxiliary_window
description: Opens an Intuition window through intuition.OpenWindow and stores the window handle in a global. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: open_main_window
description: Opens the main Intuition window and stores its handle in a global. If the open fails, it sets a global flag, and the routine carries an error message about the main window.

name: next_random_number
description: Advances a mixing state held in globals using multiply, add and shift steps, reseeding it after every 200 draws. It returns a value reduced modulo a range that the caller passes in.

name: call_handler_if_set
description: Calls the routine whose pointer is held in a global when that pointer is nonzero, then returns the register pair it was given unchanged.

name: call_handler_if_set
description: Calls the routine whose pointer is held in a global when that pointer is nonzero, then returns the register pair it was given unchanged.

name: invoke_handler_return_zero
description: Calls a routine reached through a pointer stored in data and returns zero. It is entered from outside the normal static flow.

name: call_routine_pass_registers
description: Calls a routine and returns the register pair saved on entry unchanged, so the caller sees its own register values.

name: init_channel_record_table
description: Calls two other routines, clears four channel-state globals, then scans a byte table to find a boundary. It fills a block of 30 records with pointers, clears the playback globals and sets two state flags.

name: reset_sound_channel_state
description: Clears four channel-state globals and scans a byte table to find a boundary. It fills a block of 30 records with pointers, clears the playback globals and sets two state flags.

name: stop_audio_playback
description: When the playback flag is set, clears it, zeroes the globals that hold the four audio volume values and sets the channel bits in the control value. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: advance_audio_sequence_step
description: Advances a step counter for the sequence and, when a step ends, runs a short delay loop and copies four channel pointers from a table into the audio location registers. It then reads the next track byte, which can loop the sequence back.

name: parse_music_track_event
description: Decodes one packed track event and copies its pointer, period and volume values into the channel record. Special command nibbles toggle global state flags instead of changing the channel.

name: copy_word_to_target
description: Copies one 16-bit value from a field of a caller-supplied record to the address held in a register.

name: scale_channel_volume
description: Multiplies a 16-bit value by a stored scale factor, shifts the product right by four bits, and stores the result in the channel record. The first register value is returned unchanged.

name: clamp_channel_period
description: Masks a period value to its low 12 bits and stores it in the channel record. If it matches the stored limit the value is cleared, and if it is below the limit a pending flag is set.

name: apply_channel_effect
description: Applies a per-tick effect to a channel record, such as sliding the period or changing the volume. The effect is chosen from the low nibble of the command field, with a table lookup driven by a rotating counter.

name: stub_infinite_loop
description: Decodes as an empty infinite loop in the gap between routines, so it is not a real routine.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes as an invalid instruction that stops analysis, so it is data rather than a routine.

name: stub_empty_infinite_loop
description: The recovered body is only an empty infinite loop. The task-list, memory and task-lookup library calls listed in the facts do not appear in the decompiled code.

name: release_node_countdown
description: Calls exec to free and unlink a record while a flag is clear, then decrements its countdown. When the countdown reaches zero with a flag set, it runs a follow-up routine.

name: finish_node_or_mark_pending
description: When the countdown field is zero, calls exec to free and remove the record and returns a value stored in it. Otherwise it sets a pending bit in the record and returns zero.

name: free_and_remove_record
description: Calls exec to close the library, free the record memory and remove it from its list, then returns a value stored in the record.

name: find_tagged_entry
description: Walks a block of variable-length entries, comparing each entry's first word with the requested value. It returns the matching entry's address, or zero when none matches.

name: call_and_offset_result
description: Calls another routine and adds eight to its result when a flag is clear. The rest of the decompiled body is not shown.

name: copy_counted_bytes
description: Copies a block of bytes one at a time from a source to a destination for a counted length.

name: copy_bytes_pretest
description: Copies bytes one at a time from a source to a destination, testing the count before each copy.

name: unpack_packbits_runs
description: Unpacks a PackBits-style stream: a negative control byte repeats the following byte, and a non-negative control byte copies literal bytes. It fills the destination until the counter runs out.

name: unpack_packbits_stream
description: Unpacks a PackBits-style stream in which each control byte selects a repeat or a literal copy, writing into the destination until the input length is used up.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns with no other work. It is reached only through gap decoding.

name: write_ilbm_picture_file
description: Writes an IFF picture file: it builds a FORM header with the ILBM type and a BMHD header, packs each 16-bit word into three bytes, and writes the chunks through the file library.

name: finish_ilbm_file_write
description: Completes an IFF write by checking the written size and padding it to a four-byte boundary, then closes the chunk and the file through library calls.

name: close_file_if_open
description: If a flag is set, calls a file-library routine to close the open file, then calls another routine and returns.

name: accumulate_and_write_rows
description: Builds eight running sums from table words and a scaled multiplier, then repeatedly adds the first word into each sum while calling a file-library routine to write each step. It returns the scaled product.

name: accumulate_rows_recursive
description: Fills a 72-entry buffer of running sums from table words, calls itself to total the sub-results, and writes each row through a file-library routine.

name: pack_bits_encode_stream
description: Compresses a stream in PackBits style: it counts runs of identical bytes, writes a repeat header for each run and a literal header for other data, and returns the number of bytes produced.

name: pack_bits_encode_literals
description: PackBits-style encoder that writes literal runs and repeat headers into the output buffer and returns the total output length.

name: pack_bits_encode_block
description: Packs a block into PackBits-style repeat and literal runs, writing the headers into the output and returning the total output length.

name: count_identical_run_length
description: Counts how many following bytes equal the first byte, stopping at a run limit of 128 or at the end of the input.

name: find_current_task_entry
description: Gets a value from the system through a library call, then walks a linked list and returns the node whose stored field matches it, or zero when none matches.

name: clear_field_on_flag
description: Calls another routine and, when its result is nonzero, zeroes a field in the record. It always returns one.

name: store_value_if_nonzero
description: Calls another routine, then stores the input value in a record field when that value is nonzero. It always returns zero.

name: compute_status_bits
description: Builds a status word from two record fields: it sets one bit when a value is within a limit and another bit when a second field exceeds its limit.

name: read_ilbm_header_info

name: unpack_packed_pixel_words

description: Part of diskfont.library: measures a zero-terminated string and scans backwards from its end for a given byte. It returns a pointer to the last match, or zero when none is found.

name: find_path_separator
description: Part of diskfont.library: searches a zero-terminated name for a slash and then for a colon. It returns a pointer to the first one found, or the original pointer when neither character is present.

name: collect_font_names_into_buffer
description: Part of diskfont.library: walks a list of font entries and copies name text from them into a buffer when a flag bit is set. The decompiled body is only partly recovered.

name: write_font_data_records
description: Part of diskfont.library: copies font data bytes into a buffer in a loop, reducing a remaining count and writing a record header for each chunk. The decompiled body is only partly recovered.

name: write_font_data_chunks
description: Part of diskfont.library: copies bytes one at a time from a source into a buffer, and when the buffer reaches its limit writes a record header with the stored size. The decompiled body is only partly recovered.

name: scan_fonts_dir_for_fonts
description: Part of diskfont.library: opens the FONTS: directory and examines its entries for files with the .font extension, allocating memory and locking the directory as it goes.

name: read_font_file_header
description: Part of diskfont.library: reads a block of font file data into a buffer and checks that a tag word equals 3840. Otherwise it reports a failure code.

name: read_font_data_records
description: Part of diskfont.library: reads font data from a file in a loop, copying bytes into a buffer and checking each record's tag. The decompiled body is only partly recovered.

name: read_font_name_records
description: Part of diskfont.library: reads a 260-byte block from the file, stores each record's values into a list entry and counts the entries. Library calls handle the reads and closes.

name: restore_directory_and_free
description: Part of diskfont.library: restores the current directory, unlocks the directory and frees memory through library calls. It returns the negated value of a stored result when that result is negative, or zero otherwise.

name: return_zero
description: Part of diskfont.library: returns zero with no other work.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Part of diskfont.library: calls one routine in the same module and returns, passing no values through.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Part of diskfont.library: calls one routine in the same module and returns, passing no values through.

name: handle_workbench_startup
description: Program entry point: when the process was started from Workbench rather than the CLI, it takes the startup message with Forbid and GetMsg, runs another routine, then permits multitasking and replies to the message. It returns zero.

name: wait_video_frames
description: Waits for the number of video frames given in the register, calling the graphics wait-for-frame routine once per frame. Returns nothing.

name: run_main_setup_and_menu
description: Main program routine: checks that the diskfont library and the MegaBall font are present, loads the BALL1 and BALL2 pictures and the MegaBall music, opens the graphics and audio resources, then shows a prompt to press 2 for two players or SHIFT-Q to exit.

name: poll_message_loop_and_shutdown
description: Polls the exec message port in a loop until a message arrives. When a quit state is set it runs a shutdown sequence of library calls.

name: poll_message_and_reply
description: Polls the exec message port in a loop, replying to each message that arrives. When a quit state is set it runs the same shutdown sequence of library calls.

name: update_playfield_frame
description: Per-frame update that copies memory blocks, moves sprites, clears rasters and blits bitmaps, while taking and replying to exec messages.

name: compute_scroll_step_and_draw
description: Updates per-frame timing values, computes a scroll step from a width field and calls the drawing routines once per pass.

name: advance_playfield_buffers
description: Counts down a row counter and, when it reaches zero, swaps pairs of display buffer pointers and clears their state. Otherwise it moves on to the next row update.

name: draw_scroll_band_rows
description: Advances an offset by 40 bytes and draws bands of rows in a loop, computing a step size from a width field and clamping it between 12 and 265.

name: reset_frame_state_and_update
description: Increments a frame counter, clears four state fields, then enters the shared per-frame update that draws rows and computes the scroll step.

name: set_pending_flag_then_update
description: Sets one status flag word to one and continues into the common per-frame update that draws rows and computes the scroll step.

name: advance_shift_and_update
description: Doubles a shift value up to a limit, clears a pending entry, then continues into the common per-frame update that draws rows and computes the scroll step.

name: set_alt_flag_then_update
description: Sets one status flag word to one and continues into the common per-frame update that draws rows and computes the scroll step.

name: set_third_flag_then_update
description: Sets one status flag word to one and continues into the common per-frame update that draws rows and computes the scroll step.

name: set_fourth_flag_then_update
description: Sets one status flag word to one and continues into the common per-frame update that draws rows and computes the scroll step.

name: remap_tile_codes_in_table
description: Walks a table of byte codes. Codes above four are rewritten to a fixed value (5 becomes 0, 7 becomes 3, 11 becomes 2, others become 10), and a routine is called for each rewritten cell.

name: fill_tile_codes_row
description: Writes tile codes along a row, mapping the previous code 7 to 3, 11 to 2 and other values to 10. It skips codes below five and calls a routine for each cell written.

name: cycle_tile_codes_row
description: Writes tile codes along a row in a repeating pattern starting from two, calling a routine for each cell until the row ends.

name: blit_tile_row_codes
description: Writes tile codes along a row starting from three and blits the cell bitmap for each cell through the graphics library.

name: set_two_flags_then_update
description: Sets two status flags to one and continues into the common per-frame update that draws rows and computes the scroll step.

name: cycle_buffer_pointer_slots
description: When the playback flag is clear and a buffer slot is set, cycles a counter through four buffer slots and loads the next nonzero slot pointer. Otherwise it runs two update calls.

name: select_next_buffer_slot
description: Selects the next nonzero buffer slot pointer from four slots using a rotating counter, then runs a routine.
